title: 第013章 燕家族会第014章 竖敌
content_zh:
第013章燕家族会
这一次，陈默一眼就看出老道心中所想，轻轻从沙发走到茶几边缘。
“修炼一途，逆天而为。不以年龄论辈分，只用实力分尊卑。”
陈默满脸严肃，像一位站在武道顶端的大师，指点乾坤。
咔嚓！
陈默并指如刀，对着棕色的实木茶几一角急速劈落。那比砖块还要结实坚固的实木茶几一角，顿时被整齐的切割下来，切口无比平整。
即便是未入凝气境，陈默如今实力，堪比内境小成武者，老道望着那断掉的茶几一角，丝毫没有心疼，反而一脸激动：“内境武者，掌出如刀，切金断玉，不在话下！”
“我有眼无珠，不识真人，惭愧！”
老道噗通一声跪在陈默面前，一脸庄严肃穆：“师傅在上，请受徒儿一拜！”
陈默点点头，露出满意之色，这老道虽然年纪不小，但心思聪慧，可堪造就。
“起来吧！”
陈默随手虚空一托，老道觉得一股无形之力托起自己身体，让他不由自主的缓缓站起。
这下，老道心中再无丝毫疑虑，对陈默的实力，彻底认可！
陈默背负双手，一脸严肃：“想要入我门下，你现在还不够资格，暂且收你当记名弟子吧！”
老道现在对陈默不敢有丝毫怀疑，虽说只是记名弟子，但，只要能修炼武道，他也心甘情愿。
“弟子遵命！”老道躬身俯首，一脸尊敬道。
陈默点点头，对老道的表现颇为满意。
“我最近还有事情，等过几日我来找你，传你修炼功法。入我门下，没有过多忌讳，我不在，你可自行其事。”
说完，陈默也不管老道是否有疑问，大步离去。收下老道，只是陈默一时心血来潮，为了完成自己心中一个想法。至于这位记名弟子心中的想法，陈默根本懒得理会。
“弟子谨遵师命！”老道再次躬身行礼。

面对这么一个甩手掌柜般的师傅，老道心中虽然颇有微词，但却不敢又丝毫不敬，这一切，都要归功于老道的前任师傅对他的教导。
拿着青色玉石离开，陈默忽然想起，自己居然忘了问刚收的这位记名弟子叫什么名字了？
陈默自己都不禁哑然失笑，心中暗道：“算了，等下次再问吧！”
陈默坐出租车回到自己租的房间，立刻反锁房门，把手中那块青色玉石放在桌子上，微微用力，强大的灵力透过手掌，传入玉石。
咔嚓！
那块青色玉石立刻一分为五，五块被分割开的玉石露出晶莹剔透的核心，切口平滑圆润，形状规整。
陈默站在房间中一块空地上，运转灵力，在半空中虚画，灵力引动天地元气，在空中形成一道道肉眼可见的气流，组成一幅玄奥复杂的图案。
“聚灵阵，结！”
陈默突然一声轻喝，那幅玄奥的图案顿时覆盖在陈默周身方圆一米内，消失不见。
陈默抬手对着桌子上的玉石虚空一抓，四块玉石凌空飞向他，被他迅速打入东南西北四个方位。玉石一接触地面，立刻消失不见，诡异莫测。
就在四块玉石没入地面的刹那，周围一道道看不见的灵力，迅速向着陈默房间汇聚，院子里的那颗桂花树，枝丫无风自动。
content_en:
Chapter 013 Yan Family Meeting
This time, Chen Mo could see what Lao Dao was thinking at a glance and gently walked from the sofa to the edge of the coffee table.
"As you practice, you go against the will of heaven. Don't judge seniority based on age, only use strength to distinguish superiors and inferiors."
Chen Mo's face was serious, like a master standing at the top of martial arts, giving guidance.
Click!
Chen Mo pointed at the corner of the brown solid wood coffee table like a knife and slashed it down. The corner of the solid wood coffee table, which was stronger than bricks, was immediately cut neatly, and the cut was extremely smooth.
Even though he has not yet entered the Qi Condensation Realm, Chen Mo's current strength is comparable to that of a junior martial artist in the Inner Realm. The old Taoist looked at the broken corner of the coffee table, not feeling distressed at all, but with a look of excitement on his face: "A warrior in the Inner Realm can produce a palm like a knife, cutting through gold and jade, no matter what!"
"I am ignorant and do not recognize real people. I am ashamed!"
The old Taoist plopped down and knelt down in front of Chen Mo, with a solemn expression on his face: "Master, please bow to me as a disciple!"
Chen Mo nodded with a look of satisfaction. Although this veteran was not young, he was very smart and could be trained.
"Get up!"
Chen Mo casually raised his hand in the air, and the old Taoist felt an invisible force lifting his body, making him stand up slowly involuntarily.
At this time, the old Taoist no longer had any doubts in his heart, and he completely recognized Chen Mo's strength!
Chen Mo put his hands behind his back with a serious look on his face: "If you want to join my sect, you are not qualified yet. Let me accept you as a registered disciple for now!"
The old Taoist dare not have the slightest doubt about Chen Mo now. Although he is only a registered disciple, he is willing to practice martial arts as long as he can.
"Disciple, obey your orders!" The old Taoist bowed his head and said with respect.
Chen Mo nodded, quite satisfied with the performance of the veteran.
"I have something to do recently. I will come to you in a few days to teach you how to practice. There are no taboos in joining my sect. You can do your own thing while I am away."
After saying that, Chen Mo strode away regardless of whether the old man had any doubts. Accepting the old way was just a whim of Chen Mo, in order to complete an idea in his heart. As for the thoughts in the mind of this named disciple, Chen Mo didn't bother to pay attention to it.
"Disciple, please obey your master's orders!" The old Taoist bowed and saluted again.
Facing such a hands-off master, although Lao Tao had some complaints in his heart, he did not dare to be disrespectful at all. All this was due to the teachings given to him by Lao Tao's former master.
After taking the blue jade and leaving, Chen Mo suddenly remembered that he had forgotten to ask the name of the registered disciple he had just accepted.
Chen Mo himself couldn't help but laugh, and thought to himself: "Forget it, let's ask again next time!"
Chen Mo took a taxi back to the room he rented, immediately locked the door, put the piece of blue jade in his hand on the table, and exerted slight pressure, powerful spiritual power was transmitted into the jade through his palm.
Click!
The piece of blue jade was immediately divided into five pieces. The five divided jade pieces revealed their crystal clear cores, with smooth and round cuts and regular shapes.
Chen Mo stood on an open space in the room, using his spiritual power to draw virtual paintings in mid-air. His spiritual power activated the vitality of heaven and earth, forming airflows visible to the naked eye in the air, forming a mysterious and complex pattern.
"Spirit Gathering Array, knot!"
Chen Mo suddenly shouted softly, and the mysterious pattern immediately covered Chen Mo within a meter around him and disappeared.
Chen Mo raised his hand and grabbed the jade stone on the table. Four pieces of jade flew towards him in the air and were quickly knocked into the four directions of southeast, northwest and northwest by him. As soon as the jade stone touched the ground, it disappeared immediately, which was strange and unpredictable.
The moment the four pieces of jade were submerged into the ground, the invisible spiritual power around them quickly gathered towards Chen Mo's room. The branches of the osmanthus tree in the yard were moving automatically without the wind.
